item_name: Rothco Womens Shadow Ops Waterproof Rain Jacket
item_short_desc: Silence the storm with our Shadow Ops Waterproof Rain Jacket. Unlike the typical bulky rain coat that makes a lot of noise as you move, these high-performance, ultra-light rain jackets remain quiet, provide unparalleled wind and rain protection, and offer extreme comfort. The outdoor jacket has a waterproof rating of 5,000mm that easily endures harsh outdoor weather conditions.
description: Silence the storm with our Shadow Ops Waterproof Rain Jacket. Unlike the typical bulky rain coat that makes a lot of noise as you move, these high-performance, ultra-light rain jackets remain quiet, provide unparalleled wind and rain protection, and offer extreme comfort. The outdoor jacket has a waterproof rating of 5,000mm that easily endures harsh outdoor weather conditions. Move with Silent Precision: Built to keep you comfortable and on-the move, our Active Flex stretch technology is ready to tackle any challenge, offering flexibility and ease of movement. These raincoats feature a sleek and silent design that utilizes our Shadow Ops fabric that is engineered with waterproof properties and a fabric that is quiet while you move. All-Weather Protection: These womens raincoats come equipped with a drawstring hood, full-length zipper with a snap-button storm placket, zipper storm guard, adjustable hook & loop cuffs, and a drawstring bottom for keeping wind and rain out. The 2 zippered hand pockets and 2 interior drop pockets provide ample storage space for essentials. Perfect Fit: The comfortable outdoor rain jacket features raglan style sleeves and adjustable drawstring waist that is carefully crafted for versatility, functionality, and all-day comfort. Ready for Adventure: The lightweight rain jacket is great for camping, hiking, running, outdoor work, everyday wear, and more. From the trails to the streets, the rugged rain shell ensures you remain dry and comfortable.
